# ============================================================================
# IBM/Kenexa BrassRing "Talent Gateway" (modern TGnewUI) gateways.
# One `slug,partnerid,siteid[,host]` line per gateway (# = comment).
#   slug      -> the human-facing employer key, and the display name
#   partnerid -> the gateway's BrassRing partner id (from the careers URL)
#   siteid    -> the specific Talent Gateway / site id (from the careers URL)
#   host      -> optional; defaults to sjobs.brassring.com (a few use krb-sjobs)
#
# PROBED 2026-07-28. 33 of these 46 pairs are now registered in
# internal/services/brassring.go.
#
# Every pair was POSTed once to
#   https://<host>/TGnewUI/Search/Ajax/ProcessSortAndShowMoreJobs
# with {"partnerId","siteId","keyword":"","location":"","activeFacetCategories":
# [],"selectedFacets":[],"pageNumber":"1","pageSize":"50"}, sequentially with a
# 1.5s pause, because sjobs.brassring.com is one shared backend for every
# gateway and every page is a real server-side search.
#
# Result, measured and not estimated:
#
#   ok      34   JobsCount > 0                          63,825 postings
#   empty   12   HTTP 200, JobsCount 0, "Job": []
#
# 33 of the 34 are registered; "nats" is not, see below. The 33 published
# 63,819 postings at probe time, about 50 per HTTP request.
#
# Provenance of the 46: 30 come from dtunkelang/job-search
# slugs/brassring_tenants.txt (its "(~N)" annotations are kept verbatim below as
# that curator's counts, dated 2026-06); 16 more were recovered from web search
# of sjobs/krb-sjobs careers URLs and probed the same way.
#
# TWO CLAIMS IN docs/research/ats-platform-survey.md DID NOT SURVIVE THE PROBE,
# and both matter for how a health check should classify this platform:
#
#   1. "A wrong partner/site pair answers HTTP 500 (not an empty feed)" is only
#      half true. A pair that is not a gateway at all (99999/99999) does answer
#      500 with an HTML error page. But a real gateway that has been retired or
#      has nothing published answers HTTP 200 with JobsCount 0 and an empty
#      "Job" array — 12 of the 46 did exactly that, including three the upstream
#      list had verified live six weeks earlier (cdmsmith, lockheedmartin,
#      trinnex). So 500 means "no such gateway" and 200-with-zero means "nothing
#      published", and only the first is a transcription error.
#   2. The survey's "one other implementation uses PowerSearchJobs, which DOES
#      need a CSRF token + cookie" reads as though ProcessSortAndShowMoreJobs
#      might need one too. It does not. Establishing a session by GETting
#      /TGnewUI/Search/Home/Home first and replaying its cookies returned
#      byte-identical results to sending the POST cold, on every gateway tried.
#
# A third correction is recorded on the adapter rather than here: "lastupdated"
# is not always "17-Jun-2026". Three formats are live — that one, "07/27/2026"
# (5 gateways) and "27/07/2026" (1 UK gateway) — and the last two are the same
# eight characters meaning different dates.
#
# NOT REGISTERED although live: nats,30041,5722,krb-sjobs.brassring.com (6
# postings). All six share the title "Trainee Air Traffic Controller" and carry
# formtext4 values of "Test", "TEST", "1 Test Fail" and "Positive Test (all
# pass)". docs/adding-a-source.md calls that out as a sandbox artefact rather
# than a board.
#
# Promotion rule, gated on content and not on status code: keep a pair whose
# page-1 POST answers 200 with JobsCount > 0 and a non-empty Jobs.Job array
# whose members carry a "jobtitle" question and an https "Link" — which is
# exactly what internal/services/brassring.go needs to emit a posting. All 34
# live gateways carried both on all 1,506 postings captured.
# ============================================================================
